exercises.instructionEn: The films below are to be seen after the relevant units have been taught. They are as follows:
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi filmlar tegishli unitlar o'tilgandan keyin ko'riladi. Ular quyidagilar:
exercises.explanationUz:
VIDEO LOYIHALAR - BO'LIM MUQOVASI.

  Workbook oxirida 5 ta film uchun
  ish varaqlari bor. Har film
  ma'lum unitdan KEYIN ko'riladi:

     Unit 2  - Anastasia (93 daqiqa)
     Unit 7  - The Man in the Iron
               Mask (132 daqiqa)
     Unit 8  - The Mask of Zorro
               (137 daqiqa)
     Unit 11 - Armageddon (145
               daqiqa)
     Unit 14 - Dr Dolittle (85
               daqiqa)

  Qavsdagi son (93') = filmning
  davomiyligi daqiqalarda.


NIMA UChUN:

  Film unit mavzusiga bog'liq:
    Anastasia - 2-unit (Night and
      Day - kundalik hayot,
      o'tmish)
    The Man in the Iron Mask -
      7-unit (Profiles - tarixiy
      shaxslar)
    The Mask of Zorro - 8-unit (A
      Brush with Danger - xavf)
    Armageddon - 11-unit (Our
      Precious Planet - sayyora)
    Dr Dolittle - 14-unit (Live and
      Let Live - hayvonlar)


QAYERDAN TOPISh:

  'Video cassettes ... can be found
  in your local video shops, or
  ordered through the Internet' -
  kitob 2000-yillar boshida
  chiqqan, shuning uchun
  videokasseta va Blockbuster
  haqida gap boradi. Hozir bu
  filmlarni onlayn topish mumkin.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  relevant   = tegishli
  to be taught = o'qitilmoq
  as follows = quyidagicha
  a video cassette = videokasseta
  local      = mahalliy
  to order   = buyurtma qilmoq
  via        = orqali

tasks.en: The films below are to be seen after the relevant units have been taught. They are as follows:

tasks.uz: Quyidagi filmlar tegishli unitlar o'tilgandan keyin ko'riladi.
tasks.note: ⚠ 'are to be seen' = ko'rilishi kerak (majhul, reja).

tasks.en: Unit 7 — The Man in the Iron Mask (132')
tasks.note: Tarixiy sarguzasht: Fransiya qiroli va uning egizagi.
Komediya: hayvonlar bilan gaplasha oladigan shifokor.

tasks.en: Video cassettes of the above films can be found in your local video shops, or ordered through the Internet via: http/www.Blockbusters.com
tasks.uz: Yuqoridagi filmlarning videokassetalarini mahalliy video do'konlaridan topish yoki internet orqali buyurtma qilish mumkin: http/www.Blockbusters.com
tasks.note: ⚠ 'can be found' / '(can be) ordered' - majhul nisbat.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the unit to the film.
exercises.explanationUz:
5 TA FILM - 5 TA UNIT.

  2 → Anastasia
  7 → The Man in the Iron Mask
  8 → The Mask of Zorro
  11 → Armageddon
  14 → Dr Dolittle

tasks.right: The Man in the Iron Mask (132')
tasks.speakAnswer: The Man in the Iron Mask

sentencePatterns.formula: NIMA + are to be + V3 + after + ... + have been + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The films are to be seen after the relevant units have been taught.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Filmlar tegishli unitlar o'tilgandan keyin ko'riladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: NIMA + can be found in ... / ordered through ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Video cassettes can be found in your local video shops, or ordered through the Internet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Videokassetalarni mahalliy video do'konlaridan topish yoki internet orqali buyurtma qilish mumkin.
